title: End-to-End CRUD Testing
description: Build a complete end-to-end CRUD test suite that creates, reads, updates, and deletes resources, verifying each step.

steps.title: Health check endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /health endpoint that returns 200, establishing the API is running.

steps.title: Create resource via POST
steps.description: Create a POST /resources endpoint that creates a resource and returns 201.
hints: Accept JSON body with resource data

steps.title: Read resource via GET
steps.description: Add GET /resources/:id to read a resource and verify the data matches what was created.
hints: Verify the returned data matches the created resource

steps.title: Update resource via PUT
steps.description: Add PUT /resources/:id to update a resource and verify via GET that changes persist.
hints: Accept updated title and content in the request body

steps.title: Delete resource and verify 404
steps.description: Add DELETE /resources/:id that returns 200, then verify via GET that it returns 404.
hints: Remove resource from the array by id
